---
applyTo: "docs/brand/**,src/data/**,src/catalog/**,src/pages/**,src/components/**,index.html"
description: Brand identity, creative vision, and feature-preservation rules when editing brand docs, static data, or user-facing pages.
---

- Read [docs/brand/identity.md](../../docs/brand/identity.md) before changing
  brand names, visual marks, theme palettes, lore, or product copy.
- Preserve established terminology, display formatting rules, accessible
  screen-reader names, and existing interactive features unless explicit user
  direction revises them.
- When explicit user direction revises brand or architecture canon, update
  [docs/brand/identity.md](../../docs/brand/identity.md), affected source, and
  tests together so stale bans do not override the new decision.
- Never copy verbatim text, serial numbers, or proprietary phrasing from
  external mood-board or reference artwork.
- When a creative or scope decision is unclear, keep existing work intact and
  record the question in [docs/ai/concerns.md](../../docs/ai/concerns.md)
  instead of guessing or silently removing features.
